item: Discover by topic names every site it contacts, before the click (row 224, R761)
key_paths: src/services/duckduckgo.py; src/static/net-hosts.js; src/static/app-core.js; src/static/index.html; src/static/app-backup.js; docs/SECURITY.md; tests/test_topic_discovery_disclosure_r761.py
summary: Discover by topic now tells you, before you turn it on, that besides sending your topic to DuckDuckGo it visits each site the search returns (its robots.txt, the page, the feed links it names and common feed addresses such as /rss and /feed), so each of those sites sees the visit. Disclosure only: the fetch set is unchanged; the probe list moved unchanged into FEED_PROBE_PATHS, which the consent table carries exactly, and a test runs the real discovery over a recording fetcher to tie the text to what is fetched.
